servers.name: EDITH Core MCP (Dev + Notes + Web)
servers.description: Built-in MCP server with code search, git diff stat, web page fetcher, and quick personal notes.
servers.setup_hint: Built-in — works immediately with zero external setup.

servers.name: Sequential Thinking MCP
servers.description: Structured step-by-step reasoning and problem decomposition tool (free, zero config).
servers.setup_hint: Free — requires Node.js (npx) only, zero credentials.

servers.name: Knowledge Graph Memory MCP
servers.description: Persistent local entity/relation knowledge graph memory across sessions (free, zero config).
servers.setup_hint: Free — set MEMORY_FILE_PATH in .env (e.g. data/mcp_memory.jsonl) to persist graph.

servers.name: DuckDuckGo Search MCP
servers.description: Free web search and content fetching via DuckDuckGo with no API key required.

servers.name: Context7 Docs MCP
servers.description: Fetches live, up-to-date library and framework documentation (free, no API key required).

servers.name: SQLite DB MCP
servers.description: Inspect schemas and query local SQLite databases (path configured via EDITH_SQLITE_DB in .env).

servers.name: Gmail MCP
servers.description: Search, read, draft, and send Gmail messages directly from EDITH.
servers.setup_hint: Set GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH in .env to your Google OAuth desktop JSON path.

servers.name: Google Calendar MCP
servers.description: Check today's schedule, create calendar events, and manage RSVPs.
servers.setup_hint: Set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS in .env to your Google Cloud OAuth JSON path.

servers.name: WhatsApp MCP
servers.description: Search WhatsApp contacts, read recent chats, and send messages.

servers.name: GitHub MCP
servers.description: Inspect repositories, pull requests, issues, branches, and commit logs.

servers.name: Playwright Browser MCP
servers.description: Automate live websites, test web apps, click forms, and capture screenshots.

servers.name: Projects Filesystem MCP
servers.description: Standard MCP filesystem access scoped to your EDITH_PROJECTS_DIR from .env.
servers.setup_hint: Set EDITH_PROJECTS_DIR in .env to your local projects folder.

servers.name: Notion Workspace MCP
servers.description: Search Notion pages, update docs, trackers, and meeting notes.

servers.name: PostgreSQL DB MCP
servers.description: Inspect schemas and run safe read-only SQL queries on external Postgres DBs.
